numinance.kinds.v1.BudgetPolicy.jsonsche.description: BudgetPolicy sets the per-Change and per-run limits; exhaustion pauses and escalates.

extensions.description: extensions holds vendor or customer data under reverse-DNS keys; the Engine never reads it.

metadata.description: metadata is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

spec.description: spec is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.BudgetPolicy.jsonsche.title: Budget Policy

numinance.kinds.v1.BudgetPolicySpec.json.description: BudgetPolicySpec holds the limits; an absent field is unset and comes from a wider scope.

files_changed.description: files_changed is the maximum number of files changed.

lines_changed.description: lines_changed is the maximum number of lines changed.

max_risk_escalation.description: max_risk_escalation is the highest risk class a run may escalate to.
max_risk_escalation.title: Risk Class

network_destinations.description: network_destinations is the maximum number of distinct network destinations.

repositories.description: repositories is the maximum number of repositories touched.

retries.description: retries is the maximum number of retries.

services.description: services is the maximum number of services touched.

tokens.description: tokens is the maximum model spend in tokens.

tool_calls.description: tool_calls is the maximum number of tool calls.

wall_clock.description: wall_clock is the maximum elapsed time.

numinance.kinds.v1.BudgetPolicySpec.json.title: Budget Policy Spec

numinance.kinds.v1.Metadata.jsonschema.s.description: Metadata names a kind object and fixes its scope.

name.description: name is required and unique per kind and scope; other kinds reference the object by it.

scope.description: scope is required and not SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED; the loader enforces the latter.
scope.title: Scope

numinance.kinds.v1.Metadata.jsonschema.s.title: Metadata
